verdict.rationale: Otter's AI Chat is an assistant that queries connected apps, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Otter acting as an MCP server that exposes meeting data to Claude and ChatGPT. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here. The fixed first-party CRM and app integrations in AI Chat are adjacent features, not user-pluggable MCP servers, and nothing shows Otter consuming external MCP tools.
